note: FH.7a style-agnostic drift, Go -> TS. The broken state of a json tag rename: the gin handler GetMessage writes models.Message, whose json tag `messageId` became `messageUid` (drift/base/ holds the BASE model), while the axios client's interface and the view still read `messageId` (drift/fixed/ holds the authors' client half). glia_engine::contract_breaks::name_breaks reads the rename from the diff of the server side (the route, its HANDLED_BY handler and the model the handler USES), crosses the HTTP_CALLS pair to the ENDPOINT, and walks the client's callers and IMPORTS to the two stale reads (engine/tests/name_breaks.rs builds BASE / broken / fixed as git states of this fixture). This key grades the static boundary the walk needs; the `.drift` files are never parsed. Deliberately not bound to a matrix cell: go/http_server and typescript/http_client are already scored.
